title: Concept: XML document declares an external DTD in xml — review required
description: In xml, the document names a remote DTD. Parsers that resolve external subsets issue a request to the named URL, which is server-side request forgery driven by document content. Entity definitions inside the fetched DTD can then expand into local file contents.
applicability: xml documents and templates parsed by services.
risk: Server-side request and entity expansion during parsing; MEDIUM severity.
